narrative: The leaf from last night, in the afternoon light, the lodging quiet because you are not at the play. The half-line stops where it stopped. No new words have been fitted into it. Your hand is at the margin. A new line stands below the blank, not inside it. No song. No last line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the sentence around the blank and did not fill the blank.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on draft in A twelvemonth, around a blank
